mandate.objective_outcome: synthetic enterprise process: produce an evidence-backed service exception decision with customer continuity and auditable closure
mandate.process_document_type: operational SOP plus quick-reference/checklists; draft for pilot review
mandate.audience: trained frontline operator, reviewer, process owner and control functions
mandate.trigger_start_end: start on validated exception signal; end on evidence-backed closure or authorized handoff
mandate.scope_volume_criticality: bounded B2B service exceptions; synthetic volume ranges; high data/customer-continuity criticality

sources.supports: mandatory controls, escalation, privacy, retention and authority
actual steps, handoffs, wait/rework and local workarounds
trigger, state, timestamps, volume ranges, exceptions and record gaps
failure modes, containment, escalation and customer harm
RACI, SOD, competence, access and backup
system of record, fields, evidence, access, retention and rollback

sources.source_type: quality/customer continuity and pilot test evidence
sources.supports: acceptance, UAT cases, quality/control metrics and continuity

process_boundary.trigger: signal passes validation/dedup and enters EXCEPTION_NEW
process_boundary.system_of_record: versioned synthetic exception register; other systems referenced, not mutated by this Skill

roles.accountability_tasks: process outcome, scope, control design and improvement backlog
roles.sod_conflicts_controls: cannot perform and independently approve critical closure

roles.accountability_tasks: validate, classify, document and execute only authorized steps
roles.decision_approval_authority: routine decision within approved decision table
roles.backup_handoff: qualified backup operator and explicit handoff
roles.sod_conflicts_controls: cannot approve own high-risk exception or change policy
not operator on reviewed critical case
cannot conceal incident or approve outside policy

roles.accountability_tasks: operational capacity, exception authority and continuity
document control, walkthrough, training records and version distribution
roles.decision_approval_authority: document completeness only; no process activation
roles.sod_conflicts_controls: cannot certify competence without evidence or retire version without authority

process_steps.trigger_input: new authorized signal/event and source metadata
process_steps.action_decision_rule: validate source, scope, identity/dedup, required fields and consent; reject/quarantine invalid input
process_steps.output_acceptance: validated EXCEPTION_NEW record or documented rejection
process_steps.sla_basis: event risk and current observed handling range; target pending pilot

process_steps.action_decision_rule: classify type/severity/urgency/customer impact using approved decision table; unknown goes review
process_steps.sla_basis: severity-based decision table, not universal duration

process_steps.action_decision_rule: apply only approved reversible containment within authority; otherwise escalate before action
process_steps.output_acceptance: containment proposal/evidence and customer continuity state
process_steps.sla_basis: risk threshold and approved containment contract
process_steps.system_record_evidence: before state, proposed/authorized action and evidence

process_steps.action_decision_rule: review evidence, policy/control/SOD/customer harm; approve/deny/request data within authority
process_steps.output_acceptance: versioned human decision, conditions and expiry
process_steps.sla_basis: severity/escalation matrix and on-call coverage evidence
process_steps.system_record_evidence: decision owner, timestamp, rationale, conditions and review evidence

process_steps.action_decision_rule: authorized operator executes outside this design Skill; record before/action result without exceeding scope
process_steps.output_acceptance: external action evidence or safe failure/rollback evidence
process_steps.sla_basis: authorized decision conditions and system execution contract
process_steps.dependencies: external system access and approved change/action

process_steps.action_decision_rule: independently verify after state, acceptance, control and customer continuity; fail routes recovery
process_steps.sla_basis: control verification window from authorized action
process_steps.system_record_evidence: after snapshot/hash, acceptance tests and reviewer

process_steps.action_decision_rule: restore/continue service, communicate through authorized channel and preserve minimum evidence
process_steps.system_record_evidence: continuity status, communication approval/evidence and residual issue

process_steps.action_decision_rule: check closure criteria, residual risk, record completeness and improvement candidate; critical case needs separate approver
process_steps.output_acceptance: CLOSED record or reopened defect with owner
process_steps.sla_basis: closure evidence completeness, not elapsed-time shortcut
process_steps.system_record_evidence: closure checklist, decision, residual risk and learning link

exceptions.escalation_threshold_route_sla: material/customer-impact gap to process owner and data owner by severity matrix
exceptions.evidence: gap, source versions and attempted resolution
exceptions.recovery_rollback: obtain authorized source or close as invalid

exceptions.condition_detection: system of record unavailable or write fails
exceptions.containment_allowed_deviation: approved minimum offline form; no restricted data beyond contract
exceptions.escalation_threshold_route_sla: continuity route to operations director based on outage impact
exceptions.evidence: outage, offline record hash and custody

exceptions.escalation_threshold_route_sla: immediate controlled-function route per current incident policy
exceptions.evidence: minimum incident facts and chain of custody

exceptions.containment_allowed_deviation: safe hold and customer continuity; no self-approval

controls.objective_type: prevent invalid/duplicate intake and incomplete closure; preventive/detective
controls.pass_fail: all required fields, dedup and acceptance evidence pass
incompatible duties separated and acceptance verified

controls.event_frequency: each record plus periodic review by policy
controls.pass_fail: minimum authorized fields and complete audit trail

controls.evidence: review decision, conditions, expiry and closure
controls.pass_fail: authorized decision and all conditions met

metrics.purpose_formula_grain: flow; median and range from valid trigger to verified closure by exception type
metrics.denominator_cohort_window: closed valid cases; type/severity cohort; fixed review window
metrics.target_sla_basis: baseline/pilot and risk-specific service contract; target pending

metrics.purpose_formula_grain: quality; first-pass accepted closure / reviewed closures
metrics.denominator_cohort_window: reviewed closure cohort and fixed window
metrics.target_sla_basis: pilot baseline and approved quality target

metrics.purpose_formula_grain: control effectiveness; passed critical controls / applicable controls
metrics.target_sla_basis: critical controls require pass; other target by policy

metrics.denominator_cohort_window: closed case cohort and fixed window
metrics.target_sla_basis: pilot baseline and approved improvement threshold

metrics.purpose_formula_grain: workload/capacity; active WIP by qualified role and severity
metrics.denominator_cohort_window: available qualified-role capacity and current queue

metrics.purpose_formula_grain: outcome/harm; verified continuity failures or validated customer harm / material cases
metrics.denominator_cohort_window: material-case cohort and fixed review window
